title: CraftUtopia Xini Terminal Demo Log
intro: Readable 1800-event JSON log generated from data/system.log plus the agreed demo flow, tool/skill inventory, and terminal log style. Visible text uses subtask vocabulary and highlights tool calls and skill reuse.

meta.format: run-events JSON with terminal-style plain-text lines

vocabulary.visibleTerminology: Use subtask for all demo-facing task units.

sourceAnchors: task board creation and first subtask publish: data/system.log:325-326
